newsitem.title: USA: Edison, IBM offer Internet access.
newsitem.headline: Edison, IBM offer Internet access.

text.p: Edison International's Edison Select announced Monday an agreement with IBM to provide personal computer users high-speed access to the Internet.

IBM will provide the Internet access through it's global network offering local dial access from 860 cities and 100 countries, while Edison Select will provide the user interface as well as the sales and marketing of the service.
Edison is initially marketing the service in the San Diego region, making this the unit's first foray out of Edison's own service territory, said spokeswoman Carolyn Murray.
The company plans to next expand marketing efforts to other parts of Southern California, she added.
